plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)
deployment: Deployed with `sudo ovhost deploy events`: /opt/openvibe.events, unit openvibe-events, 127.0.0.1:4300; public at https://openvibe.events (plan T7: the API and product origin; realtime SSE, health, token-guarded /api/v1/events, /api/v1/subscriptions, /api/v1/checkpoints; /api/v1/deliveries host-local; the old events.openvibe.network address was retired on 2026-10-10); real traffic since 2026-09-23 (Live, Media, Chat, Games, Network and OpenRestream publish; on 2026-09-23 8 subscriptions, held by Search, Tips, VIP, News and Reviews); restore drill passed 2026-09-23
features: durable event store with the canonical envelope
subscriptions with signed webhook delivery (v1 and v2), retry, dead letters and replay
pull consumers with cursors and checkpoints

tiered retention (ADR-042 decision 8): hot events past EVENTS_RETENTION_DAYS move to the events_archive replay tier (EVENTS_REPLAY_RETENTION_DAYS, 365; 0 = off), read with the same cursor; monthly NDJSON archive export and restore by operator job (scripts/events-archive.js; local directory or S3-compatible bucket)
realtime SSE with cursor resume, gap reports and Network tickets
developer-app publish, read and subscribe with sandbox separation, SSRF-guarded webhooks and project quotas

queue-operation-64kb billing readings (platform.usage-sample@1) per production project and closed hour, posted to Billing through billing.usage.record (EVENTS_BILLING_INTERVAL_MS, off by default; docs/cutover-events-billing-readings.md)

carrier fabric (ADR-042): the pg-v1 poll beside a valkey-v1 push carrier for QUEUE (streams) and TOPIC (SSE fan-out) an optional nats-v1 NATS Core TOPIC carrier (NATS_URL) and an optional nats-js-v1 JetStream STREAM carrier (NATS_URL, NATS_JETSTREAM; deploy/nats) and an optional cloud-v1 SQS-compatible QUEUE carrier (CLOUD_QUEUE_URL; SigV4, no dependency), with a placement planner, per-key pinning, delivery_placements history and a GET /api/v1/placement explain API; EVENTS_CARRIERS[_DISABLED] switches it
at_most_once delivery semantics (a failed attempt is final)
